PluginData.Author: Ashley
PluginData.Tooltip: Makes asteroid/terrain walls count as airtight surfaces for oxygen rooms.
PluginData.Description:
Part of Project_Extensio.
Patches the oxygen room flood-fill (MyGridGasSystem) so that solid voxel faces — asteroid rock, planet terrain — are treated as airtight walls.
This means you can hollow out an asteroid, seal every opening with blocks or leave it against solid rock, and actually pressurise the interior.
Results are cached to minimise voxel storage reads during room recalculation.
